label: Heidegger shifted Husserlian consciousness phenomenology to fundamental ontology of Dasein
description: Martin Heidegger adopted Edmund Husserl's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Edmund Husserl's perspective to Martin Heidegger's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis era.

label: Formulated and introduced Intentionality & Phenomenological Reduction (Epoché)
description: Edmund Husserl formulated and introduced the concept of "Intentionality & Phenomenological Reduction (Epoché)", which became a seminal contribution in mind philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in mind.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis as part of Edmund Husserl's canonical writings.
